title: ULTRON prioritized limitation remediation plan

phases.title: Close safety and governance blockers before any live maintenance
actions: Keep all existing live services and databases untouched until an explicitly authorized maintenance plan exists.
Resolve manager ownership using process-start identity, parentage, executable/command identity, and manager artifacts; do not infer ownership from a PID, port, missing lease, or missing socket.
Before any token-bearing OMEGA adapter request, define and approve an explicit destination allowlist; do not inspect or modify OMEGA.
Obtain legal/compliance disposition for PyMuPDF and reconcile the Transformers/pypdf advisory results against the exact supported runtime and nested reference environments.
Keep trading execution blocked outside approved isolated simulation evidence.
exit_criteria: An operator-reviewed ownership/recovery procedure preserves supervision or enters a documented intervention-required state and contains no unapproved signal/adoption step.
The configured external integration destination and credential handling are constrained and covered by no-egress-on-rejection tests.
License and advisory disposition is recorded against an exact dependency inventory.
Any browser test uses normal private unlock; credentials are never requested in chat or logged.

phases.title: Establish a reproducible release and recovery baseline
actions: Have the release owner define the complete source/runtime allowlist; exclude credentials, live databases, WAL/SHM files, caches, virtual environments, and unrelated generated/reference material.
Create a versioned dependency lock/SBOM for the supported runtime and identify separately supported optional environments.
Create a SHA-256 release manifest; verify archive integrity, exact members, and restoration in a separate temporary directory.
Run the SQLite online-backup procedure only against explicitly authorized live databases after maintenance approval; preserve originals and verify integrity/schema/size/hash on a separate restore.
Reconcile operator setup, source endpoint, runtime ownership, and recovery documentation with implementation.
exit_criteria: Release identity, exact allowlist, test evidence, dependency lock, and archive restoration are independently verified.
A protected rollback release is identified and restoration is rehearsed.
A protected, schema-verified database backup and separate restore are verified before deployment authorization.

phases.title: Complete isolated subsystem acceptance without expanding authority
actions: Test CRE contracts on isolated data, clearly distinguishing implemented local stages from unavailable pipeline, publishing, and analytics capabilities.
Verify authenticated gateway, session expiry/revocation, stale/error states, reconnect, owner-scoped CRE data, scene-image decode, and authorized owner isolation through the normal browser unlock.
Test voice origin/rate/resource limits while preserving loopback binding.
Exercise privacy permissions, history retention/deletion, diagnostic persistence, and corruption paths with temporary stores.
Run focused and broad simulation-only regression suites plus full static/import checks against the exact locked release environment.
exit_criteria: Every result is tied to an exact source/release identity and isolated fixture or authorized browser session.
No test weakens authorization, trading, rights, publishing, recovery, or fail-closed behavior.
No source capability is described as live merely because its unit test passed.

phases.title: Make a separate operator deployment decision
actions: Prepare a maintenance plan scoped to the verified release and exact service owner; include prechecks, approved change steps, stop conditions, rollback, protected database backups, and post-checks.
Obtain explicit operator authorization for the actual maintenance window and exact operations.
Do not start a competing manager, adopt processes, modify databases, deploy, publish, or perform financial actions under this audit.
exit_criteria: All critical/high deployment gates have direct supporting evidence.
A rollback artifact and protected database restore are available and verified.
The operator has approved the exact maintenance plan. Until then, decision remains NO-GO.

phases.title: Address longer-term product and evidence gaps
actions: Only if product owners request it, design missing CRE pipeline stages, publishing integrations, analytics provenance, agent routing, privacy lifecycle, and voice protections.
Keep uncertain backup/reference code until per-file evidence rules out dynamic, external, test, migration, or recovery use.
Do not perform broad cleanup or refactoring based solely on age, scanner labels, or complexity metrics.
exit_criteria: Each new capability has an explicit authority boundary, source of truth, persistence/recovery contract, UI state, and tests before it is represented as available.

safest_next_action: Maintain NO-GO and request an operator-owned, read-only manager-ownership resolution and approved release-scope decision before any live maintenance or deployment.
validation_rule: Each referenced limitation ID must exist in docs/ULTRON_LIMITATION_REGISTER.json; no phase authorizes live action without separate operator approval.
